findings.title: Cached visual approvals do not cover shared rendering dependencies
findings.problem: The reuse key covers the diagram's own JSX, prompt and example screenshots, but not shared rendering sources such as kit.jsx. Nevertheless, this branch replaces the cached entry's sourceKey with the current whole-source key. That certifies changed shared logic without submitting it to the diagram reviewer.
findings.failure_scenario: A change to Gauge's out-of-range marker handling affects an ABG with PaCO₂ below the displayed scale, but not ABG_EXAMPLE or any captured frame. The diagram JSX and screenshots remain identical, so canReuse returns true and the old PASS receives the new sourceKey. Rebuilding the map then republishes existing pairings against that changed rendering logic without a new visual/clinical review.
findings.fix: Include the relevant transitive rendering sources in both the review request and its cache key. Do not carry a PASS to a new sourceKey unless its review covered those dependencies. Add a regression test that changes a kit.jsx branch not exercised by the example and verifies that the cached approval cannot be reused.

findings.title: A transcription failure discards the synthesized take
findings.problem: keepTake is called only after transcribe succeeds. If transcription throws, the catch records an error and continues, but the already-paid MP3 exists only in the local variable and is never written to the audit artifacts. This contradicts the new guarantee that every paid take is retained.
findings.failure_scenario: TTS successfully returns a recording, then the transcription endpoint exhausts its retries with a 429/503 or encounters a network failure. The run saves an error report but loses the recording, leaving nothing to audit or retranscribe. A job stopped while awaiting transcription has the same loss.
findings.fix: Persist the MP3 and an incomplete take record immediately after synthesis, before awaiting transcription. Finalize that record with the transcript/check or transcription error afterward. Test a throwing transcriber and verify that the take is retained while no clip is published.

assessment: Not ready to merge. The hardening addresses many genuine gaps, but visual approvals can still be reused across unreviewed rendering changes, and transcription failures still discard paid recordings. This was a static review; tests/build and the external GitHub environment/App restrictions were not verified.
